method.scope: all 50 canonical gallery registry rows; exact declared slot targets only
method.selected_input_limit_boundary: Metadata pages/provenance/route map were read as selected inputs; target file reads were limited to the 3368 exact full/thumb paths.
method.thumb_url_rule: full URL with .jpg replaced by -thumb.jpg in the same directory
method.dom_only_slider_rule: No exact native full/thumb src in the page plus one valid literal addshots() declaration.
method.guide_preview_rule: Guide preview sections are retained and counted separately; their nested thumbs never enter the 3368 native target rows.
method.provenance_rule: A v39 provenance match is route-keyed and may have multiple entries; all roles and source paths are retained in compact form.

source_boundaries: The registry is a frozen 50-gallery/1684-slot expectation and its historical CDX statuses are not reused as current file availability.
A missing exact file, provenance entry, or route-map entry is reported as missing/unknown for this local checkout; it is not a remote 404 or proof of historical absence.
Source15 and original offline files are compared only at exact native full/thumb target paths; guide collections and nested thumbs are counted separately.
Pillow decode is local file evidence. It does not prove browser deployment, remote capture validity, or public reachability.
No source manifest, ZIP, raw response, private page, or unrelated image directory was scanned.

full_window_partition.source: v6 partition plus accepted EARLY01/02/03 early-window records

guide_metadata.separation_rule: Nested thumbs, guide preview images, missing SVGs, comments, and expression URLs are excluded from the native target set; only the literal addshots()/printPages() JPEG rules generate native targets.
